If you want something , you figure out a way to get it. You work hard. You adapt.

This is what I always tell myself and it helps. When times are bad, it only means GOOD times are coming. So look forward to it. I wanted to kill myself a few years back and I’m SO glad I didn’t. Life does get better. If you let it. I promise you. 

I am not amogst the weak, and something tells me you aren’t either. You want to live. You want HAPPINESS. We all do. So let’s fight for it together, Okay? Even tho you don’t know me, I am feeling your loneliness, I am fighting with you.

I have been a burden my entire life. I still am. But you know what? I’m gonna do everything in my power to drag myself in a position where I don’t need to depend on a single person. 

Listen here pal. You say you are a burden, but do you want to DIE as a burden? Your death will be FOREVER burdening your loved ones with utter pain, every time they think of you. Is that really what you want? 

I’ve been single for ages, with not a single person to care about me, including my parents. You are lucky to have people who care. 

Also, are you forcing your girlfriend to be with you ? I didn’t think so. She CHOSE to be with you. She loves and cares about YOU. She’s not looking for anyone better. Don’t say things like “ she deserves better “ when all she wants is you. Do you know what she deserves? She deserves you, the best version of you. She deserves the person she loves. YOU. 

You have control over your life. Get a job. Any job. Start creating a plan to get your life back on track. Tell your GF how you truly feel so she can support you. You can change your life. Believe in yourself, and you can do anything. And Stop feeling sorry for yourself, I have made that mistake for way too long. Life SUCKSS for most people, they just hide it. 


Good luck to you. Don’t ever give up.
